node.statement: Scalar C*-bootstrap and conclusion: using nodes 1.1 and 1.2, the exact C*-identity in the source, and the epsilon-C*-axioms in the target, there are universal K_norm and e_norm>0 such that (1-K_norm e)||X||<=||gamma_n(X)||<=(1+K_norm e)||X|| for all n and X whenever e<=e_norm.
